1.consolidated_definition: Planta arborescente de hasta 25 m de altura, de tallos muy gruesos, de color verde amarillento, erectos, leñosos, huecos y nudosos, ramas casi horizontales y hojas lanceoladas y colgantes; se emplea para hacer cercas y construir viviendas. Poaceae; Bambusa guadua.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree-like plant reaching heights of up to 25 m, with very thick, greenish-yellow stems that are erect, woody, hollow, and knotted; branches are almost horizontal and lance-shaped leaves hang down; it is used for making fences and constructing dwellings. Poaceae; Bambusa guadua.
